tasks.title: Define Note model and validation functions
tasks.description: Create the Note interface and StorageFile interface in models module. Implement validation functions: isValidTitle, isValidContent, isValidId, parseNote. Export types and validators.
acceptance_criteria: file models/index.ts exports interface Note with fields id (string), title (string), content (string), created_at (string)
file models/index.ts exports interface StorageFile with fields version (number), notes (Note[])
file models/index.ts exports function isValidTitle(title: string): boolean that returns false for empty string and strings longer than 200 characters
file models/index.ts exports function isValidContent(content: string): boolean that returns false for strings longer than 10000 characters
file models/index.ts exports function isValidId(id: string): boolean that returns true only for UUID v4 format (regex /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)
file models/index.ts exports function parseNote(data: unknown): Note that throws on invalid input

tasks.title: Implement NoteRepository with JSON file persistence
tasks.description: Create NoteRepository class in repository module. Implement readAll, writeAll, findById, findByKeyword methods. Use Node.js fs module to read/write ~/.notes/notes.json. Support configurable file path via NOTES_FILE_PATH env var. Implement file locking with lockfile. Create backup before each write.
acceptance_criteria: file repository/index.ts exports class NoteRepository
constructor accepts optional filePath parameter (defaults to ~/.notes/notes.json)
readAll() returns Promise<Note[]> and reads JSON from file path
writeAll(notes: Note[]) writes pretty-printed JSON to file path and creates backup in ~/.notes/backups/notes-{timestamp}.json
findById(id: string) returns Promise<Note | null>
findByKeyword(keyword: string) returns Promise<Note[]> matching keyword in title or content (case-insensitive)
on corrupted JSON file: readAll() rejects with error message containing 'Invalid notes file'
on file not found: readAll() returns empty array
on write: acquires lockfile at ~/.notes/notes.lock and releases after write

tasks.title: Implement NoteService with business logic
tasks.description: Create NoteService class in service module. Implement add, list, delete, search methods. Validate input using models. Generate UUID v4 and ISO 8601 timestamp for new notes. Delegate persistence to NoteRepository.
acceptance_criteria: file service/index.ts exports class NoteService
constructor accepts NoteRepository instance
add(title: string, content: string) returns Promise<Note> with generated id (UUID v4), created_at (ISO 8601), and stores via repository
add() throws on invalid title or content (message includes validation error)
list() returns Promise<Note[]> sorted by created_at descending
delete(id: string) returns Promise<void> and removes note from repository
delete() throws with message 'Note not found' if id does not exist
search(keyword: string) returns Promise<Note[]> matching keyword in title or content (case-insensitive)

tasks.title: Implement CLI commands with Commander
tasks.description: Create CLI entry point using Commander. Implement add, list, delete, search commands. Parse arguments, call NoteService, format output. Handle errors: print to stderr and exit with code 1. Handle usage errors with exit code 2.
acceptance_criteria: file cli/index.ts exports function run(argv: string[]): Promise<ExitCode>
command 'note add <title> <content>' calls service.add and prints created note id to stdout
command 'note list' calls service.list and prints each note as '[ ] <id> <title> (<created_at>)' on separate lines
command 'note delete <id>' calls service.delete and prints 'Deleted note <id>' to stdout
command 'note search <keyword>' calls service.search and prints matching notes in same format as list
on missing arguments: prints usage to stderr and exits with code 2
on service error: prints error message to stderr and exits with code 1
on success: exits with code 0

tasks.title: Add path traversal protection for NOTES_FILE_PATH
tasks.description: In repository module, validate that the resolved NOTES_FILE_PATH is within user's home directory or a subdirectory. Reject paths that escape via '..' or absolute paths outside home.
acceptance_criteria: file repository/index.ts exports function isPathSafe(filePath: string): boolean
isPathSafe returns false for paths containing '..' that escape home directory
isPathSafe returns false for absolute paths not under home directory
NoteRepository constructor throws if filePath fails isPathSafe check
error message contains 'Path traversal detected'

tasks.title: Add output sanitization for terminal display
tasks.description: In cli module, sanitize note title and content before printing to stdout to prevent terminal injection. Escape special characters like newlines, escape sequences, and control characters.
acceptance_criteria: file cli/index.ts exports function sanitizeForTerminal(text: string): string
sanitizeForTerminal replaces newlines with space
sanitizeForTerminal removes ANSI escape sequences (regex /\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g)
sanitizeForTerminal removes control characters (ASCII 0-31 except tab)
list and search output uses sanitized title and content
